Section: Overview

Controls:
- numbers 1-9 pick a visible action
- Enter opens the full chooser
- ? opens this help overlay
- / opens the smart command palette (names, aliases, task words)
- Esc goes back
- shortcuts are on

Palette examples:
- try: first run, triage, bundle, report, logs, doctor

Actions:
- dashboard: Open: live operations dashboard [d]
- status: Open: current status snapshot [s]
- back: Back to main menu [b]
